claims.claim: Jev 1.13 is priced at $0.042 per million input tokens with output tokens free, text-only input.
Perplexity's pplx-decider-v1-27b Decisions API costs $0.04 per million input tokens, output free, no per-request fee.
Cloudflare Workers AI prices Clef at $0.240 and Clef-flash at $0.090 per million input tokens.
OpenAI's Decisions API runs on a version of GPT-6 Luna, launched as a limited preview with no published price.
pplx-decider-v1-27b, Clef and JEV-27B-VL are all built on Qwen3.8-27B and released under Apache 2.0.
Perplexity's model card reports 85.71% overall accuracy for pplx-decider vs 84.51% for Jev across 11 benchmarks, measured via Perplexity's API.
On JevBench v1.5.4, Jev 1.13.0 ranks first among Jev-class systems with capability 80.0; GPT-6 Luna scores 95.9 at $0.11 per 1,000 decisions, 3.5x Jev's cost.
The Jev Decision Index is an unofficial, community-maintained Hugging Face Space not affiliated with TypeSafe, built from public benchmarks.
The Information reported Typesafe in talks to raise $1B+ at a $10B+ valuation, about 50x its $200M seed valuation.
OpenAI's slide claims ~150 ms for the Decisions API vs ~1.6 s for a standard GPT-6 Luna call.
MotherDuck measured Jev at 89% accuracy in 40 s for $0.50 vs GPT-5.6-terra at 88% in 31m59s for $37.58 on 100k AG News rows.
AWS released Strands Decider 2B, an open-source Jev-inspired decision model built on Qwen3.5-2B.
Mimic E8 found pplx-decider costs 8.7x Jev per prediction on batches despite a lower list rate, with challengers statistically level with Jev.
GPT-6 Luna is listed at $0.10 per million input and $0.50 per million output tokens; no Decisions API row exists.
Vast.ai median H100 SXM spot price was about $2.33 per GPU-hour on 2026-10-01.
